sites.rationale: NTSR1 lacks a signal peptide; the topology landmarks place EC1 at residues 1–67, making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus. L7 explicitly reports a FLAG epitope prepended before M1 via a GTELGS linker in a full-length, membrane-anchored construct used for surface expression comparisons. insert_after_residue=0 (prepend); residue_after=M (residue 1, confirmed from sequence). The 67-residue EC1 provides ample space for a short epitope tag well clear of TM1 (≥67 residues from the TM boundary). Full-length human NTSR1 was N-terminally tagged with a FLAG epitope via linker (MDYKDDDDKGTELGS) and cloned into pcDNA3.1 for surface expression level comparisons in transfected cells. NTSR1 has no signal peptide (EC1 = residues 1–67), so the N-terminus is extracellular and the prepended tag is surface-displayed. Exactly one extracellular terminus exists (the N-terminus); the junction is topology-derived.

sources.claim: Specifically, NTSR1 was tagged with an N-terminal FLAG epitope through a linker (M DYKDDDDK GTELGS; the FLAG epitope is underlined) and inserted into the pcDNA3.1 vector. β2AR and μOR were N-terminally modified with an HA signal sequence followed by a flag epitope then a flexible linker (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA DYKDDDDK GGSGGGGSGGSSSGGG; the FLAG epitope is underlined) and inserted into the pCAGGS vector.

literature_notes: All other ledger lines (L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6, L8, L9, L10) describe C-terminal fusions (mNeonGreen, mRuby3, RlucII, Venus-YFP, Rluc8, FLAG, GFP) appended after Y418. The authoritative topology places IC4 at residues 365–418 (intracellular C-tail), so every C-terminal tag is on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as a surface tag site. These are recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports a tag insertion in any extracellular loop (EC2 124–142, EC3 207–232, EC4 326–343) of NTSR1 or a close ortholog, so no internal loop sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: NTSR1-Venus (C-terminal Venus-YFP fusion after Y418) expressed in HEK293 cells and knock-in mice; Gq activation EC50 indistinguishable from WT NTSR1 (NT: 1.08 nM vs 1.65 nM), confirming functional tolerance, but the C-tail is intracellular (IC4, residues 365–418) and not a surface-tag site.

NTSR1-mNeonGreen (C-terminal mNeonGreen fusion after Y418) expressed in HEK293T FlpIn cells for live-cell FLIM imaging; surface receptor confirmed by imaging but tag is on the intracellular C-terminus.
NTSR1-RlucII (C-terminal RlucII fusion after Y418) expressed in HEK293 cells for ebBRET internalization assay; functional surface receptor confirmed but tag is intracellular.
NTSR1-Rluc8 (C-terminal Rluc8 fusion after Y418) expressed in HEK293 cells for BRET saturation and internalization assays; tag is on the intracellular C-terminus.
NTSR1-FLAG (C-terminal FLAG after Y418) overexpressed in HEK293T and HT29-KD cells; detected by anti-FLAG western blot of total cell lysate; tag is intracellular.
